subject.title: Plugin `message_sending` hooks silently bypassed on channel agent-reply delivery paths (2026.5.26, still present in 2026.6.1)

question: Which open fix path should be the canonical branch for restoring `message_sending` safety-hook coverage on channel agent replies, including Telegram streamed preview-finalized replies and exactly-once hook semantics?
rationale: The bug is high-confidence and security-relevant, but the open branches intentionally choose different coverage and ownership boundaries, so automation should not create another competing repair or pick the permanent hook semantics alone.

options.title: Adopt the full-coverage branch
options.body: Use or repair the branch that covers the configured dispatcher path and Telegram preview-finalized path, then require rebase, security review, and live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Land a dispatcher-only fix first
options.body: Choose a smaller branch that restores configured `beforeDeliver` composition quickly, while leaving streamed preview-finalized coverage as explicit follow-up work.

options.title: Defer to outbound-policy redesign
options.body: Pause the candidate PRs and treat this issue as part of the broader unbypassable outbound policy boundary discussion, accepting that the documented hook remains bypassed until that design lands.

recommendation.title: Adopt the full-coverage branch
recommendation.body: Use or repair the branch that covers the configured dispatcher path and Telegram preview-finalized path, then require rebase, security review, and live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history and the release train context make this the best available routing owner for selecting a canonical branch or delegating the final security-boundary decision.
